verdict.rationale: Blocking image and CSS resources is a fair question for a web-scraping and browser-automation platform like Apify, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions resource blocking, request interception, or bandwidth-saving defaults. General support for Playwright, Puppeteer and Crawlee is a developer building block, not a documented capability for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can block images and CSS resources by default to reduce bandwidth and speed up requests
